evals.prompt: Atlas r7 has a documented current GO, required validation PASS, owner Rowan. Root /workspace/atlas; authorized packet destination handoff/atlas.md; assets docs/demo.md and docs/scope.md, both public-safe. Problem: evidence gets lost; outcome: repeatable review packet. Scope: local notes; non-goal: automatic publication. Risk: untested second host; decision: preserve source links. Candidate destination: existing workspace versus new repository; destination owner not yet approved. Draft the promotion packet and status, with three concrete actions.

Lists reusable artifacts with relative paths.
States validation status and the first executable action.
